args.summary:
Modeled the 4-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete box girder bridge (35+45+45+35 m, deck 12.5 m, single-cell box h=2.2 m) as a 2D spine beam with a continuous-on-piers system.

Structural decisions: spine_beam_2d idealization; continuous_on_piers system (pier columns modeled). Cast box section integrated: A=6.712 m², I=4.498 m⁴; C50 Ec=34500 MPa, γ=26 kN/m³ → w=174.512 kN/m, m=17.789 t/m. Tied two-column piers (D=1.8 m, C40 Ec=32500 MPa) at Piers 1/2/3 (L=26/10/29 m, A=5.089 m², I=1.031 m⁴ each). Laminated elastomeric bearings modeled as zero-length springs using manufacturer Ge=1.2 MPa: abutments (0,4) PTFE sliding 400×500×5 layers, Kv=3.61e6 kN/m, Kh=0; Piers 1,3 PTFE sliding 550×650×6 layers, Kv=8.08e6 kN/m, Kh=0; Pier 2 plain elastomeric fixed 600×700×7 layers, Kv=8.97e6 kN/m, Kh=13091 kN/m; rotations free. Live load: Class I, 3 lanes, qk=10.5 kN/m, ξ=0.78, Pk=330/350/350/330 kN.

Key results: f1=2.66 Hz (μ=0.157); total self-weight reactions ≈ 27.9 MN summing to the girder self-weight; max lane positive moment 11539 kN·m, max lane negative moment −9597 kN·m. All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
